text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-59931 - node gpu-eu-09 reported KUBELET_NOT_READY and GPU_UNHEALTHY
pagerduty-bot: Alert triggered at 2024-10-18T07:46:39Z. Rule: kube_node_not_ready (node=gpu-eu-09). Severity: P1. Auto-escalate in 5m if unacked.
ravi-oncall: acked on PD, taking this. i'll triage until 10:00Z. :wave:
kim-sre: pinged. can you grab kubectl outputs and any console logs? i'll prep cordon/drain if needed.
ravi-oncall:
```
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpu-eu-09      NotReady   gpu      23d   v1.27.6
gpu-eu-01      Ready      gpu      120d  v1.27.6
```
```
$ kubectl describe node gpu-eu-09
Conditions:
  KubeletReady  False   KernelOopsDetected   kubelet crashed after kernel oops on nvme driver
Non-terminated Pods: 21
Taints: node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute
```
infra-alex: joining. provider serial console shows "Kernel panic - not syncing: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference" around NVMe init, plus errors referencing `nvidia` shortly after. snippet:
```
[  256.112233] nvme nvme0: queue memory allocation failed
[  256.112244] kernel: Kernel panic - not syncing: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000000
```
kim-sre: likely hardware fault or driver corruption. plan: cordon+drain, enable CPU fallbacks, attempt soft reboot, collect dmesg/journal, open RMA if bootloop.
ravi-oncall: executing drain now, honoring PDBs and checking statefulset disruptions.
```
kubectl cordon gpu-eu-09
kubectl drain gpu-eu-09 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=45
```
kim-sre: drain progressed; most pods rescheduled to gpu-eu-01. couple of long-running batch jobs failed due to quota; owners notified.
routing-bot: temporary route override deployed: fallback to `cpu-eu-stable` for groups: hosted-eu, enterprise-eu. TTL 2h. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: customer notices sent to affected customers: "We're investigating an issue affecting some GPU inference jobs in EU. Temporary fallback to CPU models has been activated. We'll update within 90 minutes."
infra-alex: attempted soft reboot via provider API. host rebooted but bootloop persists at kernel panic during nvme init. collecting `journalctl -b -1` and `dmesg` for attachment.
infra-alex: opened vendor ticket VEND-4412 with provider; requested hardware diagnostics and RMA. provider indicates possible NVMe/PCIe fault; spare ETA 4-6 hours for region.
kim-sre: given ETA, spinning up reserved GPU spare pool and expanding CPU fallback capacity to reduce impact.
```
# infra action
terraform apply -var='node_pool=reserved-eu-spares'
```
kim-sre: terraform apply succeeded, new spares provisioning. scheduler is rebalancing pods.
ravi-oncall: monitoring metrics: generation 5xx spike up to 4.1% for EU prior to fallback. after routing override, 5xx down to 0.9% but p95 latency for affected customers increased ~25%.
support-bot: two customers filed high-priority tickets: CUST-2002 and CUST-2044. CUST-2002 is reserved capacity customer experiencing job timeouts. account team alerted.
infra-alex: attaching kernel logs to VEND-4412 and requested NVMe SMART dump and core images. vendor requested host isolation to avoid cross-tenant impact. marking node for replacement.
vendor-ops: RMA created, shipping ETA 4-6 hours. will post tracking and escalate if ETA slips.
kim-sre: handoff plan: ravi will stay for one more hour to watch scheduler and customer tickets; i'll take follow-up until replacement closes. adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-host-failure
ravi-oncall: acknowledged. i'll continue monitoring and update PD incident. leaving notes in incident timeline.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation timer reset by ack from ravi-oncall. Next escalation in 2h.
kim-sre: summary for runbook: "gpu-eu-09 kernel panic during NVMe init -> kubelet crash -> NotReady. Node cordoned/drained, CPU fallback applied, reserved spares provisioned, vendor RMA VEND-4412 opened. Impact: transient 5xxs for ~3% of EU traffic; two customer tickets; Sev2. Handoff to kim-sre."
infra-alex: will follow up with vendor when NVMe forensic results available and post back. attaching collected `dmesg` and `journalctl` snippets to PD.
ravi-oncall: last check 2024-10-18T08:12:50Z. continuing to monitor. :mag:
